snippet.title: Super Among Us 64 DS Download
snippet.description:
HAPPY NEW YEAR!!

Credit to the SM64DS Hacking Discord Server for offering help with various problems.
Join the SM64DS hacking Discord Server here: https://discord.gg/NYyFMe3

DOWNLOAD: https://drive.google.com/file/d/18RIMaARJszTyxJ8dkD5fQj7JPX_yPFuW/view?usp=sharing
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/solarz
Discord: https://discord.gg/GkPruBS

Comment if you want more maps/multiplayer!

This Super Mario 64 DS romhack is compatible with real NDS hardware, DeSmuME, and presumably all other platforms capable of running NDS roms.

Music featured in this video:
Among Us Drip Theme [Black Metal Version] - DMT (the original was copyrighted, enjoy)
Among Us Victory Sound Composition Thing - me
Mii Theme - Nintendo
Skyloft - Nintendo
Mariokart 8 Theme - Nintendo
Super Smash Bros. Wii U/3DS Menu Theme - Nintendo
Wii Rainbow Road - Nintendo
Wii Moonview Highway - Nintendo
The Star Festival - Nintendo

This project and all others are unpaid other than donations via Patreon, so consider donating above!
